integrity: The open primary PDF was inspected at the single-cause density and survival functions, the general progressive competing-risks likelihood, specialized likelihood Eq. (3.1), expanded log-likelihood Eq. (3.2), posterior Eq. (4.2), and Metropolis–Hastings target. A later same-model bootstrap article was checked for broader coverage. The factor discrepancy is algebraic and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the printed product likelihood and Bayesian posterior; the expanded classical log-likelihood is consistent with the stated model.
Unavailable implementation code was not inspected, so no claim is made that the published numerical Bayesian tables used the defective printed kernel.
The finding does not recompute the source's simulation or real-data posterior summaries.
title: The printed Gompertz–Lindley Bayesian posterior omits a censoring factor
